quality_rule: v2 token-semantic (drop entry; drop exit iff direct vsc->all_clear withdrawal)
quality_rule_rationale: code 7 marks withdrawal onset (C); only direct withdrawals contaminate the exit lap; decided before scoring

window_definitions.ACTIVE: driver-lap rows with token vsc strictly inside [start_s, end_s], dropping the run entry lap always and the exit lap on direct vsc->all_clear withdrawal (rule v2); sensitivity on strict interior laps
window_definitions.POST: up to 3 all_clear laps after end_s (after vsc_ending run when present), pit laps excluded
window_definitions.PRE: up to 3 all_clear laps immediately before start_s, same drivers, pit laps excluded for pace metrics
window_definitions.contamination: SC/red-adjacent runs excluded at episode level; pit/retirement laps excluded per metric (retirement = driver absent all later laps: retrospective label, fixed before outcome comparison)
